Soojin — draft below and attached "redline_MSA_section-security.docx" with tracked changes. Key design choices: keep broad inspection rights scoped by time, purpose, and artifact list; limit frequency to reduce operational burden.

Proposed exhibit language (summary):
- Inspection window: Customer may conduct inspections or commissioned penetration tests no more than once per rolling 12 months; any test requires at least 30 days' prior written notice.
- Duration & scope: On-site or remote inspections are limited to a maximum of 3 business days per inspection and to systems/services explicitly listed in Exhibit A (in-scope services).
- Approved vendors: Pen tests must be performed by vendors on Redwood's approved vendor list; any vendor changes require prior written approval (reasonable commercial standards).
- Data handling & redaction: Any sensitive artifacts provided will be redacted or delivered via secure share; Redwood will provide an evidence manifest listing available artifacts and a custodian point of contact.
- Confidentiality & limitations: All inspection materials are designated confidential; any distribution or publication requires mutual written consent.
- Remedies: If a test materially degrades service or causes incidents, we retain right to suspend/terminate the test, and the parties will cooperate on remediation; limited carveout for emergency lawful access requests.

We can accept providing SOC 2 Type II under NDA (standard bridge NDA OK). For a POC/order form, recommend we: 1) add a short-order-form appendix that pins the evidence cadence to 'quarterly for POC' and 2) include the inspection-limiting language above.

Attached: redline_MSA_section-security.docx (Word doc with tracked changes)

-Karthik

Soojin/Karthik — quick compliance notes to pair with legal's draft: 

- Approved vendor list: We maintain a short list of pen-test partners who meet our onboarding controls (background checks, scoped rules of engagement). We can allow customer-supplied vendors but require 1) proof of liability insurance, 2) signed RoE, and 3) a pre-test scoping call.
- Testing windows & safety: We prefer tests run in a dedicated staging environment where possible. If in-production testing is requested, require a maintenance window (we can make Tue/Wed 02:00-05:00 PT available) and a detailed test plan 7 days prior.
- Evidence cadence: For the POC we can provide a compact evidence bundle quarterly: SOC 2 Type II excerpt (controls mapping), redacted config snapshots, and a 30-day log sample. Full report access requires NDA and standard eDiscovery process.
- Artifacts & handback: We will provide an evidence manifest with delivery via secure link (Drive folder ACL'd). Any logs containing customer PHI/PII will be redacted; if deep forensic artifacts are requested we need a legal justification and a narrow scope.

I'll attach the SOC excerpt we usually share for POCs (SOC2-TypeII-excerpt.pdf). Happy to join the call with CypressBio to walk through operational constraints.

-Laura
